spans.s: Evict,Ⓒv. t.ⒹniHsf c., nirAkf 8 U, bahizkf, aDikArAt svatvAt-BraMS c. or cyu c.

Evidence,Ⓒs.ⒹsAkzyaM, pramARaM, prAmARyaM, nidarSa-naM; ‘written e(vidence)’ leKapramARaM, sADanapatraM; ‘ocular e(vidence)’ pratyakzapramARaM, cAkzuzajYAnaM.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹpramARIkf 8 U, pramARena sAD c. or vi-BU c. or upa-pad c.

Evident,Ⓒa.Ⓓspazwa, suspazwa, sPuwa, parisPuwa, vyakta, viSada, prakASa, pratyakza, prakawa; ‘make e(vident)’ pra-kAS c., Avizkf 8 U, spazwIkf, vi-vf 5 U, viSadIkf; ‘to be e(vident)’ spazwIBU 1 P, &c.
Ⓝ[Evident]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹspazwaM, sPuwaM, vyaktaM, pratya-kzaM, nAma, oft. with eva.

Evil,Ⓒa.Ⓓduzwa, pApa, Kala, kutsita, asADu, niMdya, aDama, pApin, asat, garhya, garhita, vAcya; gen. ex. by dur, ku, apa, asat, pApa in comp.; ‘e(vil) intentioned’ pApASaya, durbudDi; ‘e(vil) passions’ durvikArAH; ‘e(vil) eye’ kudfzwi f., pApadfzwi f.; ‘e(vil) course’ kupaTaH-mArgaH, asatpaTaH; ‘e(vil)-conducted’ durAcAra, apa-karman, durvftta; ‘e(vil) doer’ durvfttaH, kukarman m.; pApakarman m., duzkftin m., pApakft m.; ‘e(vil) minded’ durAtman, pApamati-budDi, duzwamati, kumati, durmati, durbudDi, pApASaya; ‘good or e(vil) acts’ SuBASuBakarmARi; ‘e(vil) speaking’ durAlApaH, piSunavAkyaM; ‘e(vil)-tongued’ durmuKa, muKara, abadDamuKa, kadvada.
Ⓔs.ⒹanizwaM, ahitaM, aSuBaM, apAyaH, aBadraM, arizwaM, duHKaM.
